focus_area: Websocket round-trip contract: backend broadcast payload (extract_job_criteria_job.rb#broadcast_completion) -> GlobalChannel -> WebsocketGlobalChannelHandler JOB_CRITERIA_EXTRACTION_COMPLETE case -> JobCriteriaExtractionCompletePayload type -> useAiJobCriteria query/mutation. Verified field-for-field and query-key consistency end-to-end.

findings.title: Backend broadcasts errorMessage but the WS handler never consumes it
findings.description: extract_job_criteria_job.rb:57 conditionally adds payload[:errorMessage] to the broadcast, and JobCriteriaExtractionCompletePayload declares errorMessage?: string (aiSummaryWebsocketPayloads.ts:34), but the JOB_CRITERIA_EXTRACTION_COMPLETE case (WebsocketGlobalChannelHandler.tsx:250-261) never reads payload.errorMessage. The 'other failure' branch shows a static generic toast ('Could not generate job criteria for {jobTitle}'). This is intentional per SPEC 8.6 (static, button-free, no interpolated error) and exactly mirrors the AI_SUMMARY_COMPLETE analog, which also carries errorMessage in its payload/type but does not read it in the handler (lines 216-234). No behavioral consequence; recorded only as an observation.
findings.recommendation: No action. Spec-compliant and analog-consistent. The carried errorMessage is available for the REST payload / future copy without affecting the toast.
